claims.statement: The filtered rooted family generated by F3 has actual order 2p+1 for p=3,...,7; at p=6 and 7 its 418 and 1221 eligible generated rows have strictly negative complete sums, with maxima -212 and -844.
claims.scope: Only the F3 rooted child-type filter, not all trees of those orders and not the first-order shell.
claims.reason: retained: AF proves the generator adds two vertices to branch weight 2p-1 and independently subset-checks its maximum rows; the rooted-family arithmetic remains bounded and generator-dependent.

claims.statement: At order 14 and p=6, the 240 eligible trees among 3159 generated free-tree classes have complete S at most -222, attained; the convex-hull LP over those 240 actual columns has the same maximum.
claims.scope: Exact finite n=14,p=6 shell slice, conditional on the pinned centroid generator and subset replays; no variable-rank assertion.
claims.reason: retained: AF reconciles the finite maximum and LP dual. The LP is a restatement of the finite column maximum, not a structural universal bound.

claims.statement: Adding one leaf at root 0 of the specified order-91 T_22 produces an order-92 tree with alpha=68, x=33; at every eligible p=35,...,45 its marked leaf and all other original leaves are selected, and every complete S is strictly negative.
claims.scope: One specified root-leaf attachment and its eleven eligible ranks; no longer attachment or padding family.
claims.reason: retained: AF carries exact root-conditioned polynomials and selector/full-sum replays. The unpadded positive local term at p=34 has negative complete S and is no target refutation.

claims.statement: On the eligible first shell, S(T,p)<=0 if each selected leaf deletion forest admits an ordering of its one-per-component marks with first H-degree at least 2 and second H-degree at least 1 when present.
claims.scope: Finite ordinary T, x+2<=p, strict 3p<2alpha+1, |T|=2p+2, fixed strict original F and the displayed per-selected-tag root ordering; empty F allowed.
claims.reason: retained: AT first-mark partition and the in-range/zero-extension shadow bound make every residual nonpositive. The AU repair does not affect the subclass because its second root is required nonisolated.

claims.statement: On the eligible first shell, S(T,p)<=0 if every selected H_v has no isolates and a marked root of H-degree at least 2; also tau(H_v)=p+1-(alpha(T)-p)<=floor(p/2)+1.
claims.scope: Eligible first-shell ordinary trees with the stated condition for every selected original leaf; cover coordinate holds for each original leaf.
claims.reason: retained: AT reduces the sign to T1 ordering and proves alpha(H_v)=alpha(T)-1. The extra structure is not derived from favorability, and the cover bound alone gives no sign.

claims.statement: For every eligible path P_n with n>=4, both endpoint tags are selected and S(P_n,p)=2[i_(p-1)(P_(n-4))-i_(p-2)(P_(n-4))]<=0.
claims.scope: Exact path subclass of the primary, fixed original strict selector and zero-extended ranks; no branching-tree conclusion.
claims.reason: retained: AT gives the binomial path coefficients, adjacent-ratio comparison, endpoint favorability and sign proof; its through-order-150 replay is only a cross-check.

claims.statement: For rooted ordinary U with added r-s-v, I(T)=(1+z)I(U)+zI(U-r), alpha(T)=alpha(U)+1, I(T-v)=I(U)+zI(U-r), and the new leaf term is Delta_(p-1)(I(U)-I(U-r)).
claims.scope: Every finite rooted ordinary U and zero-extended integer rank p; identities do not assume primary eligibility or imply full-sum transfer.
claims.reason: retained: AT partitions by new support s. Neither x, old selectors nor old summands follows from this recurrence alone.

claims.statement: For the direct sum over fixed selected tags of relative independence chain complexes (Ind(H_v),Ind(R_v)), S=b_(k+1)-b_(k-1)+beta_k-beta_(k-1) with k=p-1.
claims.scope: Eligible ordinary (T,p), original fixed strict F, rational chain groups and zero-extended tagged dimensions; identity only.
claims.reason: retained: AT uses relative-chain bases and rank-nullity. The equivalent inequality b_(k+1)+beta_k<=b_(k-1)+beta_(k-1) is not proved and the differential does not move between tags.

claims.statement: For each original leaf of an eligible first-shell tree, the first-mark residuals J_i=H-(N_H[w_i] union earlier marks) give q_(k+1)-q_k=sum_i(i_k(J_i)-i_(k-1)(J_i)). With nonisolated w1 first and an isolate w2 second if present, only J1 when deg(w1)=1 and J2 when w2 is isolated can have order 2k; the sum of positive residual parts is at most (L_root+L_iso)/k.
claims.scope: Per original leaf at |T|=2p+2 under x+2<=p and strict 3p<2alpha+1, k=p-1; no per-tag or global sign asserted. Equal-support tags stay distinct.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: the case-listed AU repair supersedes original AU first-root-only boundary reasoning. Literal deletion of an isolated second mark removes only that mark and earlier w1; the eligible 18-vertex fixture has |J2|=2k. The repaired two-boundary estimate follows from shadow incidence.

claims.statement: The C2-U6 fixed-p state and shell vertex-cover bound do not establish the complete selected-sum inequality on the eligible first-order shell.
claims.scope: Route-level limitation for exact registered shell, not a mathematical status award.
claims.reason: retained: evaluation data and a growing cover bound provide neither global compensation nor an eligible positive full-sum witness.

claims.statement: At each fixed p and order |T|=2p+2, I(T) and the leaf-indexed original supports plus I(T-v), I(T-{v,s_v}), I(T-N_T[s_v]) suffice to evaluate alpha, terminal x, each strict selector and complete S exactly.
claims.scope: Exact fixed-p evaluation state only; no uniform compression, census or sign theorem.
claims.reason: retained: AU gives rooted include/exclude and forest-product recurrences; the leaf-indexed list preserves equal-support multiplicity.

claims.statement: Every tree with |T|=2p+2 and strict 3p<2alpha(T)+1 has tau(T)=|T|-alpha(T)<=floor(p/2)+2.
claims.scope: Necessary arithmetic bound from shell order and alpha guard only; no x, selector or sum-sign premise.
claims.reason: retained: integer strictness implies 3p<=2alpha, then alpha>=ceil(3p/2); subtracting from 2p+2 yields the bound.

claims.statement: For every finite simple G of order m, W containing every isolate, and natural k>=2 with m<=2k+1, independent-set marked layers satisfy q_(k+1)<=q_k.
claims.scope: Exact registered graph scope; no tree, bipartite, selector, x or alpha premise.
claims.reason: retained: the actual-addability incidence identity and boundary injection of all-isolate lower sets into multiply marked upper sets give a complete informal proof; edgeless complement case is checked.

claims.statement: For every ordinary T, original leaf v and support s, natural p>=3, and |T|<=2p+1, Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s])<=0.
claims.scope: Exact registered pointwise leaf scope, with original neighborhoods and zero extension; no favorable, x or alpha premise.
claims.reason: retained: H has order at most 2(p-1)+1 and all H isolates lie in W, so the generic marked-isolate theorem applies. The eligible complete-sum corollary on this order band follows without changing the registration guard.

claims.statement: The registered complete original-favorable-leaf assertion S(T,p)<=0 at |T|=2p+2 remains unresolved. T1/T3 prove structural subclasses; two finite shell slices are negative; a corrected two-boundary fixed-selector Comp budget would suffice but is unproved.
claims.scope: All eligible finite ordinary trees with x(T)+2<=p, strict 3p<2alpha(T)+1, |T|=2p+2, fixed strict original F and every distinct leaf tag.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: AT supplies subclasses, AF bounded n=14 and n=16 slices, AU supplies a conditional decomposition, and the AU repair restores the possible isolated-second-mark boundary. None derives the two-boundary budget or supplies a positive eligible complete S.

claims.statement: The registered complete selected-sum assertion S(T,p)<=0 for all eligible ordinary trees remains unresolved. It is proved for |T|<=2p+1 and for the retained path and uneven two-hub classes; weighted-rank, flow and relative-chain formulas are exact reductions only.
claims.scope: All finite ordinary T with terminal x(T)+2<=p and strict 3p<2alpha(T)+1, one fixed strict original-leaf selector, original supports/neighborhoods and repeated tags.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: all three adjudications leave the unrestricted full-sum sign open. The order-band corollary is universal only below the first shell; finite negative rows and local positive terms provide no proof or refutation above it.

claims.statement: At p=8 the specified 18-vertex center-path tree and its extension by a leaf at old leaf 10 are both eligible with alpha=12,x=6; their full sums change from -4256 to -6267, with old tag 10 lost and new tag 18 gained. Corrected pendant polynomial cases compute surviving tags.
claims.scope: One exact encoded 18-to-19-vertex pair and elementary recurrence cases; neither sum is positive and no extension sign theorem follows.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: AU replays complete vectors, strict selectors and original summands; the residual case where old u is deleted leaves the new vertex isolated unless u is the old support, when the new closed neighborhood deletes it.

limitations: The registered first-order shell and unrestricted primary complete selected-sum assertions remain unproved and unrefuted on the permitted sources; no eligible positive complete sum is supplied.
The order-band conclusions have informal counting proofs but no Lean kernel receipt or formal award in this seat.
The corrected shell decomposition needs an unproved selector-conditioned two-boundary global compensation budget; the original C2-AU first-root-only boundary derivation is invalid.
The finite tree censuses rely on their pinned generators and subset replays and were not rerun in synthesis; the repair fixture was structurally checked but not independently re-enumerated.
